scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/assessment/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/assessment
  set jcr:title{String} to "AI Practical Assessment"
end
create service user assessment-service with path system/assessment

set principal ACL for assessment-service
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /content/dam/assessment
    allow jcr:read on /home/users
end

set principal ACL for assessment-service
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/assessment
end
create user agent-1 with password changeme-local-dev-only

set properties on authorizable(agent-1)/profile
  set givenName to "Agent"
  set familyName to "One"
  set email to "agent1@example.com"
end
create user agent-2 with password changeme-local-dev-only

set properties on authorizable(agent-2)/profile
  set givenName to "Agent"
  set familyName to "Two"
  set email to "agent2@example.com"
end
